title: fix(lint)!: the object_extension publish door judges a computed field an extension adds by the build's field-formula pass, against the extended object as served
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoWK5rFW1SUGSkDw9iatZE4f)_

Fixes #33072

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the runtime `object_extension` publish door (Studio's add-field on a `.custom` pair, `PUT /api/v1/meta/object_extension/TARGET`, the MCP and AI authoring doors) now refuses an extension whose computed field carries an `expression` `os build` refuses. No exported type or signature changes. Measured first-party exposure: 0 newly refused items.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-data` teaches `defineObjectExtension({ extend, fields })` and the computed-field rules without saying the runtime door is exempt; the door now gives the verdict the build already gives.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:运行时保存对象扩展(Studio 在 `.custom` 对上加字段、`PUT /api/v1/meta/object_extension/对象`、MCP/AI 作者)发布时,现在会对扩展新增的计算字段跑和 `os build` 相同的公式检查(同一条规则、同一份遍历,不另写一套);公式调用不存在的函数、读对象上没有的字段,发布返回 422 `INVALID_METADATA`,报错的规则 id 和位置与 build 打印的一致:`object '对象' · objectExtensions[0] · field '字段' expression`。存储型字段读关联记录/时钟/当前用户只给提示,不拒。
- 为什么改:#33070 之后 build 会拒这类扩展字段,但运行时发布口只跑了保留词检查,于是 build 拒的计算字段经 Studio 仍能发布,之后每行读出 null 或报错;两道门对同一字段判法不一致。
- 风险与回滚:收窄(以前能发布的坏公式扩展现在会被拒);第一方实测 0 处受影响(showcase 的扩展 3 个普通字段、plugin-auth 的扩展 1 个 secret 字段、HotCRM 没有对象扩展,均无计算字段)。草稿保存不受影响;已存的行要再次发布才会被判。对象保存口与 build 行为不变(有对照测试)。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`(`extensionWrite`:扩展写只跑扩展字段遍历,对象遍历与其它遍历读空列表并提前返回)、`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`(`runtimeTypes` 加 `object_extension`)、`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-object-extension-item.test.ts`(真实保存+发布口的 #33072 一节)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/runtime-gate.object-formula-writes.test.ts -t "#33072"`,预期 10 条全过,其中 `sqrt(record.amount)` 在扩展发布口被拒、位置与 build 相同,合法公式照常发布。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`.** `validateStackExpressions` declares `object_extension` in `runtimeTypes`, so `runtimeAuthoringRulesFor('object_extension')` answers `validateStackExpressions`, `validateSecurityRoleWord` (registry order).
- **`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`.** On an `object_extension` write (`runtimeWriteType`), `runStackExpressionPasses` runs exactly one pass, by construction: #32875's extension walk (`judgeFieldFormula` over each field of each `objectExtensionsByTarget` entry). The object walk and the flows walk read an empty list under it, and the function returns right after the extension walk, so the top-level actions, apps, sharing rules, hooks, bulk `confirmText` and action-copy passes never run there. No second field walk and no second fold: the door's snapshot is `{ objects: LIVE_OBJECTS, permissions, books, datasets, objectExtensions: [WRITTEN_ENTRY] }`, and the walk reads the target through the indexes the function already builds over `objectsAsServed`, so the field is judged against the extended object as served and located as the build locates it (`object 'TARGET' · objectExtensions[0] · field 'F' expression`; a one-entry stack's build prints the same index).
- **`packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.ts`.** Comment only, on the `object_extension` row of `TYPE_TO_STACK_KEY`: the expression rule crosses with it and resolves into `objects`, which every snapshot already carries, so no context collection is added.
- **`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.object-extension-door-computed-field-expression-judged.ts`** — the ADR-0087 D3 entry the narrowing owes (no D2 conversion: how a refused expression is repaired is the author's fact), registered by the changeset.
- **`.changeset/33072-object-extension-door-formula.md`** — minor, `@objectstack/lint` + `@objectstack/spec`, both declaration lines, BREAKING banner, migration.

The host side needed no change: `judgeRuntimeAuthoringRules` (`packages/metadata-protocol`) already hands every write the live `objects` (registry plus stored rows, narrowed to the written package's closure), and the `object_extension` publish reaches the same gate. An extension of an object outside the written package's closure is judged on what does not depend on that object's fields (grammar, registered functions, bare and unbound references), as the build judges an undeclared target.

## Tests

1. **`packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.object-formula-writes.test.ts`**, new top-level describe `#33072` (10 cases) at the real gate (`runRuntimeAuthoringRules`): the roster; LIT `sqrt(record.amount)` refused under `expression-invalid` at the build's location; LIT a read of a field the target does not serve refused; LIT a stored extension field reading another record is an advisory (`stored-expression-cross-record-input`), never a 422; PARITY — on one shared input (`{ objects, objectExtensions: [item] }`) the door's findings deep-equal the build's (`runAuthoringRules('build', …)`), for an error and for an advisory; CONTROL a valid formula and a formula reading a field the same extension adds publish clean; an undeclared target judged on what does not depend on its fields; the differential (a carried object's own broken formula is not the extension write's); the narrowing (an extension write's pass reads no carried object); CONTROL the object save door unchanged.
2. **`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-object-extension-item.test.ts`**, new top-level describe `[#33072]` (3 cases) through the real `saveMetaItem` + `publishMetaItem` over better-sqlite3 and the real `ObjectQL`/`SchemaRegistry`: LIT `sqrt(record.name)` on `score__c` refused `INVALID_METADATA` / 422 with issue `expression-invalid` at `object 'crm_account' · objectExtensions[0] · field 'score__c' expression`, the field not served and the row left a draft; LIT a misspelt field read refused, the message naming it; CONTROL a valid formula publishes and is served.
3. **`packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.runtime-surface.test.ts`**: the #31998 extension case's roster and `rulesRun` pins now read `['validateStackExpressions', 'validateSecurityRoleWord']`.

**Reproduction at `main` `2c98485d`** (the pins committed first, `5dae65b1`, before the fix): 8 of the 10 lint door cases red: the door's `rulesRun` was `['validateSecurityRoleWord']` and it published `sqrt(record.amount)` with 0 errors, while the build refused it with 1 `expression-invalid` at `object 'fx_ticket' · objectExtensions[0] · field 'score' expression`.

<details><summary>Ablations (fix committed first, mutated through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

| # | Mutation | Expected | Observed |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `object_extension` dropped from the rule's `runtimeTypes` (`authoring-rules.ts`), lint rebuilt, dist marker proved absent by `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs --absent` | lint door pins and the runtime LIT pins red, controls green | lint: 8 failed / 41 passed (the 7 #33072 roster-dependent cases + the #31998 roster pin); runtime (reads `dist/`): 2 failed (both LIT), CONTROL passed |
| 2 | the object-walk fence on an extension write removed (`for (const obj of objects)`) | the narrowing pin red, the differential pin green | 1 failed (the narrowing pin) |

Each restore read `blob == HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` empty; the restore leg of 1 rebuilt lint, the preflight read the marker back in 4 built files, and the runtime pins passed 3/3. A first attempt at ablation 1 was a no-op (anchor miss, refused by the tool, nothing written); it is not counted.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Exposure, measured at `2c98485d`:** `objectExtensions` / `object_extension` producers in `examples/**`, `packages/apps/**` and HotCRM (`4f0ffd8`): `examples/app-showcase/src/data/extensions/account.extension.ts` (3 plain fields: select, url, number) and `packages/plugins/plugin-auth` (1 `secret` field on `sys_sso_provider`); HotCRM none. 0 carry an `expression`, so the door refuses nothing first-party.
- **Ruling grep** (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔`) over the surface at base: `validate-expressions.ts` 28, `runtime-gate.ts` 32, `authoring-rules.ts` 63, `validate-security-posture.runtime-surface.test.ts` 16, `meta-object-extension-item.test.ts` 1, `runtime-gate.object-formula-writes.test.ts` 0. The ones that bear on this diff: the per-write snapshot is not widened for cross-item judgments (rulings `5791822697` item 3 and `6104584601`, `validate-expressions.ts`) and ⛔ no context row "for symmetry" (`runtime-gate.ts`): this diff adds no context collection and no snapshot key. None is reversed.
- **File surface:** `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-object-extension-item.test.ts` is the publish door's own test file; it is added to for the end-to-end door pin. No production file outside `packages/lint` changes.
- **Location agreement is index-exact for a one-entry stack.** The door's snapshot always holds the written entry at `objectExtensions[0]`; the build of a stack with several extensions prints that entry's own index (and `packages[j].manifest.objectExtensions[i]` in an artifact stack). Rule id, object, field and message are the same in every case.
- **What the door still does not judge:** an extension's `validations`, which the build does not judge as extension items either (#32875 judged fields only).
- **Release:** 18.4.0 shipped before this PR opened, so this rides the next release train.

## Verification

All readings at HEAD `8c1950cb` (merge of `origin/main` `9433d4f3` into `c237a74a`; the 2 incoming commits touch only `skills/objectstack-data/**` and `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, none of this diff's files) unless noted.
